assertions.name: half_sym_projection_count_5_over_16_NOT_1_over_8
assertions.source: Naive count: half-sym-count (5/2) / total-cells (8) = 5/16 ≠ 1/8. The factor closing 5/16 → 1/8 is the open categorical step. Marked FAIL to flag this as the research-grade gate.

description: Probe-level investigation of the Strategy I bijection: H_4 half-symmetric Wedderburn projection ↔ canonical 8-cell ideal-tetrahedron decomposition of 𝓑_3. Verifies the per-cell volume identity Vol_i = G (Catalan) for each of the 8 ideal tetrahedra in Thurston's canonical triangulation, and the 8·G = Vol(𝓑_3) sum. Identifies the bijection as a COUNTING + ORIENTATION map (not a structurally distinguished cell), with the deeper categorical operation as the open research-grade step.

half_sym_projection_target.interpretation: If Π_½(τ^(2)) = (1/8)·(−Vol(𝓑_3)) = −G, then Strategy I's −G·h² correction is correct.

bijection_proposal.8_tetrahedra_indexed_by: (component_pair, ideal_vertex, hemisphere) ∈ {(12), (13), (23)} × {N, S} × {top, bot} / equiv (after stabilising 1 redundant gauge)
bijection_proposal.naive_count_mismatch: 8 tetrahedra vs 5 partitions — bijection is NOT 1-1 at the partition level. Must operate at the d_λ-weighted level or the half-symmetric quotient level.
bijection_proposal.half_sym_quotient_count: 5/2 (= 2 pairs + 1/2 self-conjugate). At the half-symmetric-weighted level, 5/2 'effective' Wedderburn blocks vs 8 cells → projection ratio 5/16 (NOT 1/8). This discrepancy suggests the bijection involves a finer structure — perhaps weighted by d_λ²/4! (Plancherel weights) or by a hyperbolic-geometric weight per cell.
bijection_proposal.open_question: Strategy I's load-bearing claim is Π_½(τ^(2)) = -G = -Vol/8. But the natural Wedderburn projection ratio from H_4 to half-symmetric is 5/16 (half-sym count / total tetrahedra), not 1/8. The factor that closes 5/16 → 1/8 is the open research-grade categorical step. Likely involves the outer S_4 → S_3 quotient (Borromean ring symmetry) selecting a sub-quotient of the half-symmetric image.

caveats: RESEARCH-GRADE: this probe verifies the numerical / geometric structure (8 identical regular ideal tetrahedra, each Vol = G, sum = 8G = Vol(𝓑_3)). The OPEN bijection step is closing the count mismatch: half-symmetric Wedderburn projection naturally gives 5/16, not 1/8. The factor that closes 5/16 → 1/8 likely involves the outer S_4 → S_3 quotient (Borromean ring component permutation) selecting a sub-quotient of the half-sym image. Probe deliberately marks one assertion FAIL to flag this as the gating step.
